intro: Stylish and spacious, our wardrobe is designed for every woman's needs. Mirror shutters, versatile storage and a secure drawer give you a sense of ease, everyday!

features.title: Durable design you can count on
features.text: Built from premium CRCA steel, this almirah offers strength and durability to handle your daily storage needs. Now, relying on your wardrobe is easy and stress-free!

features.title: Extra security for peace of mind
features.text: Includes a secure drawer with a numeric lock, providing safe storage for your valuable items.

features.title: Ample storage for all essentials
features.text: Multiple shelves let you store your clothes, accessories, and more, keeping your space organised and clutter-free.

features.title: Eco-friendly finish for lasting beauty
features.text: Coated with an eco-friendly powder finish, this almirah resists rust and wear, keeping it beautiful and functional for years to come.

features.title: Mirror for added convenience
features.text: The built-in full-length mirror not only saves space but also helps you get ready with ease, enhancing your everyday routine.

name: Auraline Women Basic 2-Door Steel Almirah With Mirror Textured Coffee Brown
